function.name: _api_create_directory
function.description: Create an API group directory (symmetric to _create_informat_script_directory, operating on the API list). Deduplicated by name: if a directory with the same name exists, its id is returned directly (no duplicate). return: directory id. Pass parentId=<this id> on subsequent _api_create_define calls so all APIs of the same module are grouped together, avoiding a flat exploded API list. Use the module name as the directory name so users can recognize ownership.

name.description: Directory name, preferably the module name. A directory with the same name is reused.

parentId.description: Parent directory id, optional (omit to place at root level).
